coverage: Every build-menu model, every associated construction state, all four rotations, before and after material batching.
notes: Sites reserve clearance around physical objects; no requirement to fill each cell with geometry.
Edge clearance measures the entire visual silhouette, including canopy/roof edges. It is not a navigable-aisle guarantee.
Productive areas, occupancy assumptions and utility capacities remain separate from site size.
Existing models are retained unless replaced. No automatic save deletion.
